title: 'The Midlands has better prey' toast is printed on top of 'New notebook page: ...' and is unreadable
steps: Open Realm world with a Lv 6 hero (seed 777), stay on the Shore
Kill the first creature of a kind (first kill writes a notebook page) while the one-time Shore-fade toast fires
expected: Two readable toasts, or one stacked under the other
actual: Both float texts spawn at the same spot above the hero (realm.js:3263 uses player.y-56, the notebook page text sits at the same height) and overprint each other; neither can be read. The fade toast is once per session, so a new player can miss it entirely.

title: Assist rows are two menus deep and the Assisted tag is not set until the first hit after changing the setting
steps: Realm: Esc, 'More settings' (palette, HUD size, comfort, controls: no assist rows), then 'Sound, music, aim assist...'
Read assistInfo right after: runAssisted is false until the next damage event
expected: Assist reachable from the Realm settings list a player already opened; the tag follows the setting at once
actual: Works, but the player must find the extra 'Sound, music, aim assist...' button at the bottom of More settings. The run is only tagged when a hit is actually scaled (the fall banner did show Assisted afterwards).
